description: ACT HTS - 10 Walking and Cycling Travel (2022) is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by ACT Government Open Data. This spreadsheet replicates selected data tables from the ACT & Queanbeyan Household Travel Survey dashboard. Please refer to the attached spreadsheet on this page. About the Active Travel theme Active travel relates to any trips made by walking or cycling. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher ACT Government Open Data. Its tags are act-household-travel-survey. It offers 1 resource(s) in xlsx. The portal shows 2026-09-27 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
